value.rationale: A canonical two-exclusion-particle family on complete bipartite graphs gains a complete uniform Laplacian description and exact tree complexity at all unbounded bipartition sizes. Unlike the already-known scalar spectral gap or integrality, the 10-factor multiplicity profile encodes all relaxation modes and yields a non-obvious closed tree product; its symmetry-based block structure is intrinsically motivated, not an arbitrary slice.
